descriptions.inProgress: Having lost his glasses, Abel is unable to see anything. I can't believe the pelicans all went home while he was asleep... Let me help Abel find his glasses in the bushes nearby the #bwatchtower#k, located on the east end of The Nautilus harbor where the seagulls have gathered. And remember, #bAbel's glasses#k have horn-rimmed frames!                                          \n\n#i4031853##t4031853# #b#c4031853##k / 1
descriptions.completed: Oh~ Abel seems so happy to have his glasses back. But now that he's got his glasses back, he seems like such a different person. Do those glasses have some kind of power?
